mapper.select: SELECT r.id, r.recharge_no, r.member_id, m.real_name as member_name, r.recharge_amount, r.bonus_amount, r.total_amount, r.balance_before, r.balance_after, r.payment_method, r.status, r.paid_at, r.created_at FROM member_recharge r LEFT JOIN member m ON r.member_id = m.id WHERE r.id = #{id} AND r.deleted_at IS NULL
